notes.title: 🚀 A New Adventure Awaits. Wishlist “Mitch” Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43328310/994e4e2e3a39544520fda9281704b757c1f0fc7a.png[/img]

Hi everyone!
I can’t believe it’s almost been two years since we dropped [i]Margo[/i]! The support we’d received from this little community meant the world to us. It’s been keeping us going in the quest to make a bigger-and-better sequel worthy of the same love. 💝

We’re so excited to finally share it! Our new game, [i]Mitch[/i], is a sequel to Margo that follows up with her now far away friend. You’ll help Mitch explore her new city, work a job, and settle into her life. It will be longer, open-world, and jam packed with fun new folks. 🐕🕷️🐞🧙‍♀️🧛‍♂️🐌

We’ve been grinding, and we’re aiming to release a demo within the next few months. We plan to release the full game in 2025, but if you’re already curious, the best way to support us is by adding it to your Steam wishlist. It really helps a tiny team like ours.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315010/Mitch/?beta=0][h3][b]🌟 Wishlist Here! 🌟[/b][/h3][/url]
Thank you for all your support. We’re super excited to share this with you and can’t wait to hear what you think!

Love, Greta and Amoz.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43328310/b7bdf38956d6813db44b59c5fe7be68a4f89da42.gif[/img]
